scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api,docs --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:docs"
scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:web
